newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct kerosene sales surge 41.6 pct yr/yr - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct kerosene sales surge 41.6 pct yr/yr - MITI.

text.p: Sales of kerosene in October surged due to chilly weather in northern Japan, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Friday.
October sales of kerosene, used for heating, reached 2.1 million kilolitres (kl), up a sharp 41.6 percent from a year earlier and 57.1 percent higher than September, MITI said.
The average temperature in Japan in October was 16.7 degrees Celsius, 1.2 degrees lower than the previous year, MITI said.
Imports of kerosene soared as stockpiles were built up ahead of the winter months.
Kerosene imports in October were 209,000 kl, which represents an increase of 1,990 percent over the year earlier period, MITI said.
Increased use of automobiles and growing sales of recreational vehicles spurred sales of gasoline and gas oil to the highest level ever for the month of October, MITI said.
In October, sales of gasoline reached 4.5 million kl, up 7.4 percent compared to a year earlier, while gas oil sales were 4.0 million kl, up 4.4 percent from the previous year.
